privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This explains what Dentiq stores about you and why. It is a working draft written for the current version of the app.
collect: Your name and email address, used to create your account and send verification messages.
A password hash. Your password itself is never stored.
Your role and approval status, so moderators can control access.
Session details (IP address and browser) used to keep you signed in and protect your account.
Files and notes you upload, with their title, course, version and source information.
Your language and theme choice, kept in your browser.
use: To run your account and show you course material you are allowed to see.
To let moderators review uploads before they are shared.
We do not sell your data and we do not show advertising.
privacy.private: Material you mark as personal stays visible only to you. Shared material is visible to approved users. Access is checked on the server, not only in the interface.
privacy.rights: You can download a copy of your data and delete your account yourself, as described above. For any other request about your data, use the contact below once it is filled in.
privacy.review: This draft has not been reviewed by a legal professional. It does not claim compliance with Quebec Law 25 or any other law.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These are the working rules for using Dentiq. They are a draft and will be reviewed before the public launch.

sections.title: Who can use Dentiq
sections.body: Dentiq is for dental students. Your account may need approval before you can see shared material.

sections.title: Your uploads
sections.body: Only upload material you have the right to share. Having a file does not give you permission to redistribute it. This applies especially to past exams and course documents from professors.

sections.title: Student content and official content
sections.body: Notes and resources written by students are not official course material. Always check them against your professors' sources.

sections.title: Moderation
sections.body: Moderators may hold back, correct or remove content that breaks these rules or that you are not allowed to share.

sections.title: Study use only
sections.body: Dentiq is a study aid. It does not provide clinical or professional advice.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: These terms may change before and after launch. We will update the date at the top of this page.

legal.draftBanner: DRAFT, not legally reviewed. This text describes the app as it works today and is not legal advice.
legal.contactPlaceholder: [TO FILL IN BEFORE LAUNCH: the person in charge and a contact address for privacy requests. Nothing has been set up yet.]

exportDelete: From your profile you can download a JSON file with your own data: your profile and sign-in records, your uploads (names and details, not the files), exam questions you contributed, your notes and versions, your study data, your calendar entries and your tutor usage counts. It never contains your password or other people's data.

From your profile you can delete your account. This removes your account, sessions, notes, study data, calendar entries, tutor usage counts, personal documents and their files, and anything you submitted that was never published.

Documents and exam questions you contributed that were already published or hidden by a moderator stay, detached from your account, because other students may use them. Audit records stay without your name.
You can change your display name from your profile. Changing your email address is not available yet.

definitions.title: What each number counts
definitions.attempt: A recorded answer is one question answered in practice or in a quiz. Answering the same question twice records two answers.
definitions.scored: A scored answer is an answer checked against a verified answer: correct, partly right or incorrect.
definitions.unscored: An unscored answer was given when the question had no verified answer. It is shown but never counted in any accuracy.
definitions.accuracy: Accuracy is points divided by scored answers, where correct is 1 point and partly right is half a point.
definitions.fixed: Whether an answer was scored is decided at the moment you answer. It is not recalculated if the question is edited later or its verification is removed.
definitions.activeDay: A day with activity has at least one recorded answer or card review.
definitions.due: A card is due when its scheduled review time has passed. New cards have no schedule yet and are counted apart.

how.title: How the tutor will work once it is switched on
how.sources: It will answer only from the sources above for the course you pick: official material first, then student-contributed material, then your own notes. Nobody else's private notes or documents are ever included.
how.citations: Every answer will list the passages it relies on, with a link to each. If no source supports an answer, it will say so instead of guessing.
how.current: Current-offering material is used by default. Previous offerings are only added when you ask, and are labelled.
how.limits: Planned limits: {limit, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} per student per day, and up to {chars} characters of sources sent with each question. An administrator can change both.
how.privacy: Only your question and the selected passages would leave this server, and only after an administrator turns the tutor on and a provider is configured. Today nothing leaves.

deleted: Your account, your sign-in records and your open sessions.
Your notes and all their saved versions.
Your study data: answers, flags, flashcards, quizzes and review history.
Your calendar entries and your tutor usage counts.
Your personal documents, including the stored files.

They are detached from your account: your name and email are no longer linked to them. If you want a published contribution removed as well, ask a moderator to remove it before you delete your account.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Short answers about how Dentiq works.

start.title: Getting started
start.body: Pick your courses from the Courses page, then add notes or browse past exam questions (passes). Your answers to the first-run questions only personalize suggestions.

notes.title: Notes
notes.body: Notes are private to you unless you choose to share a document. Each save keeps a version you can go back to.

passes.title: Passes
passes.body: Passes are past exam questions. An answer is marked proposed until a moderator verifies it; always check with your course material.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: The calendar shows only entries you add. Dates from presets must be confirmed with your faculty.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Your notes and study data are private and are not sent to any third party. You can export or delete your data from your profile.

account.title: Account
account.body: Change your name, download your data or delete your account from the Profile page.
